sentences.text: The General Framework Agreement for Peace in Bosnia and Herzegovina , also known as the Dayton Agreement , Dayton Accords , Paris Protocol or Dayton-Paris Agreement , is the peace agreement reached at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base near Dayton , Ohio , United States , in November 1995 , and formally signed in Paris on 14 December 1995 .	Wright-Patterson Air Force Base	Wright-Patterson Air Force Base
These accords put an end to the - year-long Bosnian War , one of the Yugoslav Wars .	Bosnian War	Bosnian War	Yugoslav Wars	Yugoslav Wars
